rules.as: home hero (DESIGN-SPEC 3.3) + Welcome block What's New card (3.7)
rules.why:
First home row (its label is the What's New post title, the first h2/h3 on the page). The opening of the home, the statement "Your Community Eye Care Clinic, We Know You!" (a

, no row of its own), the quick-action dock and the Welcome row holding this What's New card, is rebuilt as the Daylight Canopy hero: glass statement over a blurred daylight stage, the source arch photo breaking the stage, the 4 source quick actions as a glass dock (appointment emphasised), then the Welcome block. Copy verbatim.

"Our Product Offerings:" and its list sit in the Welcome practice-copy glass sheet (over lime and sun pools), as an h3 and a plain list; the services list above it is a semantic <ul> with the lead terms in <strong> (L07). Copy verbatim.

Service tile rebuilt as a glass card in a 4-up grid on the services band; the source photo breaks out of the card top (P3) and lifts on hover and keyboard focus. Label verbatim, kept a heading (h3; the source caption was an h2: QA VH-03); the pediatric link points at the canonical URL (L09); alt="" (L12).

"Ask Dr. Deana Clifton a Question..." rebuilt as a glass Q&A panel of <details> items (L05), the first open, beside the #HeretoHelp title and the CSS green-iris illustration that overlaps the panel; shown at every width (L03). Questions and answers verbatim; "More about Dry Eyes..." points at the canonical page (L09).

rules.as: Visit block: map, NAP card, emergency card (3.12)
rules.why: "Is it an Emergency?" rebuilt as the dark-glass emergency card with an alert icon tile and a tel button, overlapping the keyless map beside the NAP and hours card (today highlighted, L16). Copy verbatim.

Sidebar card on a page COMPONENTS C.1 renders without the aside (the blog index, the platform artefacts and /location/clifton-eye-center/, whose own visit block carries the NAP and hours). Every sentence of it is on every other page's aside; tools/sentence-parity.mjs counts it as source chrome, not lost copy.

The sidebar location widget rebuilt as the aside's glass location card: the name linked to /location/clifton-eye-center/, address, "Phone:" with a tel link, the keyless map (L22) and the hours list with today tinted (L16), under the 4 quick actions. Every value from the source; the search widget above it is removed (L11 row).
The sidebar "Insurance Plans" widget rebuilt as the aside's glass insurance card, text verbatim; the empty h3 before it is dropped (L11 row).

Platform template page kept at its own URL with its content (the site header/footer copy) through the content pipeline, noindex as in the source and out of sitemap.xml. Content and function unchanged.

404 rebuilt as a plain title band with the source h1 "404" and one glass sheet holding the source copy, the 404.png plate and the source links, with the generated lens prism over its edge (own ADD row). Also emitted as dist/404.html (own ADD row). Copy verbatim.

Form page rebuilt with the Gravity Form re-created field for field (labels, descriptions, options, required marks verbatim) on solid paper fields in a glass sheet, native validation with the browser's own messages, inert with the honest notice (L23 row); the contact form's source show-if rules (Email shown for "Yes, Email Me", Phone for "Yes, Call Me") are carried (QA CS-04). Copy verbatim.
Patient forms rebuilt as glass sheets with the two PDF links as doc cards pointing at the harvested local PDFs (BUILD-DECISIONS #9; they died with the platform CDN). Copy verbatim.

Hours & location rebuilt as the visit block: the keyless map (L22) with the NAP and hours card overlapping it (today highlighted, L16), the payment accordion (<details>, L05) with the source payment icons, then the source prose in sheets. Copy verbatim.
Contact section page rebuilt as glass prose sheets under a scene title band, with the aside quick actions. Copy verbatim.

Real patient testimonials rebuilt as glass review cards (quote glyph, 5 stars with the label "5 out of 5 stars", the source quote and name verbatim); the hidden ratingValue microdata is not rendered (L14 row). The /testimonial/* singles keep their URL with the heading "Testimonial" (BUILD-DECISIONS #3), noindex.

Doctor pages rebuilt with the team card (Dr. Clifton's real portrait in an arch frame, capped at its native 225px, never beside generated imagery), the bio in a glass sheet and the source call button as a CTA band. The /our-eye-doctors/ band photo is the source's stock header, never captioned as the doctor. Copy verbatim.
Staff page rebuilt as glass prose sheets under a plain title band; the empty team module is dropped (L11 row). Copy verbatim.

Plan heading rebuilt as an interior section title over the carrier logo grid (paper chips, logos at intrinsic size, never upscaled), followed by the source list of plan names. Copy and logos verbatim.

rules.as: prose sheet, CTA band, index cards
rules.why: Insurance section rebuilt as glass prose sheets under a photo or scene title band, the source buttons as a CTA band, the child pages as index cards. Copy verbatim.

Legal page rebuilt as glass prose sheets under a plain title band at the reading measure (about 66 characters per line). Copy verbatim except the declared vendor sentences on /disclaimer/ (own REMOVE row).

Archive listing rebuilt as index cards (title links only, as the source lists them) under a plain title band; noindex as in the source; the /category/our-doctors/ search form is removed (L11 row) and its h1 is "Our Doctors" (BUILD-DECISIONS #3).

Blog summary rebuilt as a post card (date pill, title link, source excerpt, the source "Read More") in the 3/2/1-column grid of all 151 posts on the one /whats-new/ URL, in source order, no pagination (as the source). Copy verbatim.

rules.as: prose sheet (C.4) under a plain band with the date pill (C.3)
rules.why: Blog post section rebuilt as a glass prose sheet (a reading measure of about 66 characters per line, display headings, tables in a labelled scroll region, the source picture on a paper plate or breaking out as a photo figure) under a plain title band with the date pill. Copy verbatim.

The section's headings, which stand alone in the source before a composed component (the index cards, the dock row, the logo wall), are rebuilt as the plain interior section title directly above it, not as a glass sheet holding only headings; heading text and levels as in the source, a run of headings kept in source order; a source <hr> above the title is dropped (QA VIA-04). The rest of the section is rebuilt as glass prose sheets and CTA bands (article rule); on /designer-frames/ the source row background Frames-Chanel-Pink-sm renders, as-is, as the #TELLITLIKEITIS figure (QA CS-06). Copy verbatim.

Article section rebuilt as a glass prose sheet (a reading measure of about 66 characters per line, display headings, educational diagrams on white plates, photos breaking out of the sheet edge) under a scene, photo or plain title band, with the in-section rail and the aside; child pages as index cards, source buttons as a CTA band, logo walls as paper chips. Copy verbatim.
